purpose: A broad, extensible learning and exploration catalog. This registry defines subject coverage; it does not claim that every lesson, calculation engine, reading, or AI interaction is already built.
experiencePrinciples: Socrates is the central guide for critical thinking, inquiry, dialogue, and reflection.
Present cultural and spiritual traditions respectfully and in context.
Clearly distinguish scientific evidence, historical claims, traditional teachings, symbolic interpretations, personal belief, and entertainment.
Never present astrology, numerology, divination, past-life readings, or psychic-style experiences as scientifically proven prediction or diagnosis.
Allow users to explore topics independently and through cross-linked learning paths.

socratesLearningFramework.title: Clarify the question
practices: Identify what would count as an answer

socratesLearningFramework.title: Expose assumptions
practices: Ask what is being taken for granted
Consider how context changes the claim

socratesLearningFramework.title: Test the idea
practices: Check whether the reasoning is consistent

socratesLearningFramework.title: Reflect and apply
practices: Choose a practical next step without surrendering personal agency

requirements: Label the epistemic status of material where relevant.
Do not claim to verify a user's past life or supernatural identity.
Do not give deterministic predictions or advise high-stakes decisions solely from divination systems.
Avoid appropriating or flattening living cultures; provide context and acknowledge diversity within traditions.
Do not present spiritual interpretations as medical, legal, financial, or psychological diagnosis.
